experiment.interpretation: QUOTE_MISSING means structural evaluation reached retest but stopped before quote validation; it is not actionable. Reason counts include repeated per-minute observations; unique event bar IDs are listed separately.
experiment.method: Existing GBPJPYLondonBreakRetestArchiveReplay and checked-in evaluator; each configuration replayed once for each full session. No quote was supplied.
experiment.objective: Exploration for deterministic structural setup diagnostics while retaining explicit spread and freshness gates. Do not maximize signal count or infer performance.
experiment.sample: Eight complete London-local sessions, Nov 2–11 2026, GBP_JPY M1. Archive labels and transport metadata are not independently authenticated Practice receipts.
experiment.sensitivity: One factor at a time around the starter: range duration 300/600/900 s; minimum range 3/5/8 pips; maximum range 18/20/25 pips; minimum breakout 3/5/8 pips; retest tolerance 1/2/3 pips; maximum retest bars 3/5/8; maximum setup age 300/600/900 s.
